sovereign_country.strategic_role: 全球海事商船注册旗国、借鉴特拉华州公司法的非公开发行实体

business_scope.primary_industry_name: Cross-Border Procurement of Battery-Grade Lithium Carbonate Powder

meta_jurisdiction_context.jurisdiction_name_en: Republic of the Marshall Islands (unitary national corporate registry; no sub-state corporate or tax distinctions)
meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Hybrid legal system: statutory corporate law (Business Corporations Act 1990) modeled on the Delaware General Corporation Law and U.S. common-law principles, together with RMI statutory, administrative, and customary law elements; official corporate language is English
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: Compact of Free Association between the United States and the Republic of the Marshall Islands (1986, as amended 2003) - economic provisions and non-discriminatory treatment
Tax Information Exchange Agreement (TIEA) between the RMI and the United States
Pacific Agreement on Closer Economic Relations Plus (PACER Plus) - RMI signatory (signed 14 June 2017)
RMI is a member of the IMF, the World Bank Group, and the Asia/Pacific Group on Money Laundering (APG)
No comprehensive double taxation agreements or standalone bilateral investment treaties are in force as of the drafting date

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Anti-Money Laundering and Countering the Financing of Terrorism Act 2012, as amended by the Anti-Money Laundering and Countering the Financing of Terrorism (Amendment) Act 2018; Business Corporations Act 1990, as amended; Non-Resident Domestic Corporation Act 1990, as amended; Registered Agents and Qualifying Entities Act, as amended; Financial Intelligence Unit directives and FATF Recommendation 24 beneficial-ownership standards (the RMI has been under FATF increased monitoring since 2021; status must be re-verified at the filing date)
ubo_and_aml_profiling.ubo_disclosure_level: Private_Nominee_Friendly (no public UBO register; beneficial-ownership records are held privately by the licensed Registered Agent and are mandatory-disclosable to the RMI Financial Intelligence Unit, Registrar of Corporations, and other competent authorities upon lawful demand; nominee shareholders and directors are permitted but must execute parallel declarations and disclose underlying principals to the Registered Agent)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized Power of Attorney appointing the licensed RMI Registered Agent
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary public in the jurisdiction of the incorporator or ultimate beneficial owner
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille for documents originating in an Apostille Contracting State (the RMI is not a party to the 1961 Hague Apostille Convention); otherwise consular legalization at an RMI Embassy or Consulate; apostilled or notarized originals are accepted by licensed agents under the AML/CFT Act with agent attestation

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Incumbency and UBO Declaration (beneficial-ownership schedule applying the 25% ownership threshold and control test)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Each ultimate beneficial owner and authorized signatory, filed through the licensed Registered Agent
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarization plus identity verification under the AML/CFT Act; no apostille required for internal agent files; apostille or consular legalization only if onward filing with a foreign bank or authority is required

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified copy of valid passport and proof of residential address for each UBO, together with PEP and source-of-wealth self-certification
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Passport-issuing authority and utility or financial institution; certification by notary public or licensed agent
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarization and, where required by foreign banks or authorities, Hague Apostille of the notarized copy or consular legalization at an RMI diplomatic mission

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Name Reservation / Name Clearance
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Registrar of Corporations, Office of the Attorney General, Republic of the Marshall Islands
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular legalization at an RMI Embassy or Consulate, or certification by the RMI Ministry of Foreign Affairs for foreign use; Hague Apostille is not available in the RMI

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Bank reference letter and source-of-funds letter for Enhanced Due Diligence (Swift LC and wire-transfer onboarding)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Issuing or reference bank of the beneficial owner or corporate group
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Swift-authenticated bank reference; notarization not required; maintained in the internal EDD file of the Registered Agent

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Business Corporations Act of 2000, Marshall Islands Revised Code (MIRC), Title 51, Sections 53 (Certificate of Incorporation), 58 (Registered Agent and Registered Office), and 70 (Board of Directors and Officers).
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Office of the Registrar of Corporations, Ministry of Finance, Republic of the Marshall Islands (acting through licensed registered agents).
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Articles of Incorporation with Accompanying Registered Agent Consent.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No minimum paid-up capital and no escrow account requirement; the Corporation may be incorporated with zero issued shares and may issue shares as directed by the Board.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED, that the Corporation adopt and approve the Articles of Incorporation and Bylaws as submitted; RESOLVED, that the Corporation issue and register the initial share subscription to the subscriber named in the subscription agreement, subject to full payment as determined by the Board; RESOLVED, that the Corporation adopt the registered office at the address of the licensed registered agent, and that the registered agent is designated as the agent for service of process; RESOLVED, that the following persons are appointed as President, Secretary, and Treasurer, each to serve until successor is elected; and RESOLVED, that the officers are authorized to open bank accounts, execute contracts, and take all necessary actions.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Office of the Registrar of Corporations, RMI (through a licensed registered agent or the RMI Corporate Registry online portal).
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit three preferred corporate names on the prescribed name reservation form. The Registrar checks availability, distinctiveness, and prohibited terms (e.g., 'Bank', 'Trust', 'Insurance') against existing registrations. If the name is clear, it is reserved for 60 days.
required_dossiers: Name Availability and Reservation Request Form
Certificate of Eligibility from licensed registered agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is rejected or deemed confusingly similar, file the next priority name or obtain a written consent letter from the existing rights holder. An administrative appeal may be filed with the Registrar within 14 days of rejection.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Preparation and Execution of Articles of Incorporation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Licensed Registered Agent appointed by the Corporation; ultimately approved by the Office of the Registrar of Corporations.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft the Articles of Incorporation containing the corporate name, general purpose (including cross-border procurement and trading of metals and minerals), authorized share structure, registered office address, and the registered agent details. The incorporators execute the Articles before a notary public, and the registered agent executes a separate Consent to Act.
required_dossiers: Articles of Incorporation (original and two copies)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Registrar issues a deficiency notice, the incorporators have 30 days to correct and resubmit the Articles with the same filing fee. No prejudice attaches to the resubmission if cured within the cure period.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Submission of Filing and Payment of Government Fee
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Office of the Registrar of Corporations, Majuro, Republic of the Marshall Islands.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The registered agent submits the executed Articles, Consent to Act, and all supporting documents to the Registrar together with the USD 500 state incorporation filing fee. Payment is made by wire transfer, bank draft, or cashier's money order drawn to the Republic of the Marshall Islands.
required_dossiers: Government filing fee remittance of USD 500
Filing checklist and transmittal letter from registered agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Registrar queries the filing or requests additional information, the registered agent shall respond in writing within 14 business days. If the application is abandoned before processing, a partial refund of 50% of the filing fee may be obtained upon written request.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Office of the Registrar of Corporations.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Upon satisfaction of all lawful requirements, the Registrar endorses the Articles, assigns a corporate number, and issues the Certificate of Incorporation under the Registrar's official seal. The registered agent retrieves the certified documents and delivers the corporate kit to the shareholders.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Certificate is not issued within the SLA, the registered agent escalates to the Chief Registrar. A duplicate Certificate may be issued upon affidavit and payment of a replacement fee if the original is delayed or lost.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Adoption of Bylaws and First Board Meeting
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Initial Board of Directors of the Corporation (internal governance).
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The incorporators or initial directors convene a board meeting to adopt the Bylaws, approve the pro-forma First Board Resolution, appoint executive officers (President, Secretary, Treasurer), authorize share issuance to the founding shareholder, and approve the opening of bank accounts. Minutes and consents are executed and placed in the corporate records book maintained at the registered office.
required_dossiers: Bylaws approved and signed by directors
First Board Resolution executed by directors
Share subscription and register of shareholders
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If a director or officer is unavailable at the scheduled meeting, written resolutions may be circulated and executed by the requisite majority within 15 days. Any procedural defect is cured by unanimous written consent of the directors.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Not applicable – the entity is engaged exclusively in cross-border wholesale trading and procurement of battery-grade lithium carbonate powder (ISIC 4662) with no manufacturing or physical industrial facility in the Marshall Islands.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: No operating or manufacturing license is required for a non-resident Business Corporation undertaking offshore trading. A future local business license would be obtained from the RMI Division of Commerce only if the Corporation establishes physical operations in Majuro.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt – no physical project, no land disturbance, and no emission source.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: N/A – the trading activity generates no wastewater, volatile organic compounds (VOCs), or solid waste. If a warehousing or repackaging facility is later established, the operator must comply with the RMI Environmental Protection Act standards for stormwater discharge and hazardous materials storage.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Not required for a non-resident corporation with no physical premises. If a local representative office is opened in the Marshall Islands, fire safety certification from the Majuro Fire Department and a building structural inspection from the Building Inspector will be required before occupancy.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Ministry of Finance – Tax and Customs Administration (TCA), Majuro; no dedicated public e-filing portal; corporate registration processed by the Registrar of Corporations under the Office of the Attorney General.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A non-resident Business Corporation that is tax-exempt is not required to obtain a Marshall Islands TIN or VAT ID. If the entity engages in taxable local business or customs transactions, it must register with TCA by filing Form BPT-1 and the customs importer/exporter registration form, together with certified articles of incorporation, registered agent details, and a business license obtained from the local administration; no VAT ID is issued because the RMI does not operate a value-added tax system.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No check-the-box or hybrid mismatch elections exist in Marshall Islands law. A foreign-owned Business Corporation is automatically exempt from the 3% Business Profits Tax if it does not derive income from sources within the Republic of the Marshall Islands; this is a passive statutory status rather than an elective classification.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: No VAT, GST, or sales and use tax; indirect taxation limited to customs import duties under the Customs Tariff Act.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: N/A — no indirect tax registration threshold exists because there is no VAT/GST/sales tax; customs duty applies on each import shipment, and Business Profits Tax registration is triggered only by commencing any RMI-source commercial activity.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: No real-time fiscal clearance, API integration, digital stamping, or e-invoicing is mandated by the Marshall Islands tax administration; invoice integrity is governed by general commercial law, not fiscal electronic clearance rules.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Not applicable — the Marshall Islands imposes no VAT/GST on exports, and no 0% rate claim or VAT refund regime exists. Exports from a non-resident exempt Business Corporation are outside the scope of RMI taxation; an export customs declaration is nevertheless required to validate the physical and legal exit of the goods from RMI where applicable.
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: The RMI imposes no VAT that could be clawed back on exports; however, false customs declarations, misdescription of export status, or fraudulent use of tax-exempt status are subject to enforcement under the Customs Tariff Act, including monetary penalties, forfeiture of cargo, denial of exemption benefits, and criminal liability for wilful false statements. For any hypothetical BPT refund, TCA may audit records and impose interest and penalties on amounts extracted from the RMI without proper substantiation.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: The Republic of the Marshall Islands (RMI) does not maintain a central bank or monetary authority. The U.S. Dollar is the sole legal tender, and monetary policy is effectively set by the U.S. Federal Reserve. Prudential supervision of licensed banks is vested in the Office of the Banking Commissioner, Ministry of Finance, under the Banking Act 1990 and the Financial Institutions (Amendment) Act 2018.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Full convertibility in both current and capital accounts is statutory in practice because the RMI has no domestic currency of its own and imposes no exchange control law, no repatriation permit regime, and no profit remittance restrictions. Dividends, loan repayments, and liquidation proceeds may be paid freely to non-resident shareholders without central bank approval. Practical hurdles are confined to commercial bank level compliance, including source-of-wealth verification, OFAC and FATF-related sanctions screening, and correspondent bank due diligence.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: None applicable. RMI imposes no statutory timeline for repatriation, no mandatory conversion ratio, and no surrender obligation for export proceeds. A trading entity engaged in cross-border procurement may retain sale proceeds offshore indefinitely. However, where trade finance facilities are secured from a domestic bank, the lender may contractually require that export receivables be routed through and settled into the borrower's account at that bank as a condition of the credit facility.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Operational Account and Capital Escrow Account
Operational Account / USD Trade Finance Account
Development Finance Facility (not a general commercial transactional account)

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Low to Medium. RMI has no electronic money institution licensing regime; any entity taking deposits or providing payment services to RMI residents requires a banking license under the Banking Act 1990. Offshore digital EMIs and non-resident payment firms generally cannot onboard RMI-domiciled business corporations without a locally licensed bank intermediary. A practical structure is to open a USD account at a licensed foreign EMI with U.S. partner bank rails, but such EMIs typically decline RMI-registered entities unless the company provides a substantive nexus justification, audited financials, and a clean UBO profile. The RMI's DAO and Sovereign (SOV) legislation does not create an EMI passport and does not lower the banking licensing bar.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Remote onboarding is technically permitted under RMI banking practice if the following are delivered: certified certificate of incorporation, certificate of good standing, apostilled director resolutions, notarized passport copies, and a completed beneficial ownership declaration. In practice, Bank of Marshall Islands and Bank of Guam reserve the right to mandate an in-person interview for at least one director or an authorized signatory at the bank's Majuro or Ebeye branch, or alternatively to accept a live video call conducted by the bank's compliance officer under enhanced due diligence. Non-resident corporate signatories should expect the 'first account' decision to require a physical or virtual interview; subsequent accounts may proceed remotely.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Non-resident Business Corporation with possible bearer share issuance and nominee shareholder arrangements
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Certified registry extract confirming no bearer shares outstanding; signed declaration by the director confirming that bearer shares are not issued and are prohibited by the articles of association; full UBO diagram with percentages for all natural persons at or above 10%; registered agent confirmation letter; apostilled corporate resolution appointing signatories.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Unclear physical substance in the RMI (no office, no employees, pure pass-through trader)
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Registered agent agreement; local correspondence address; management services retainer; board resolutions evidencing substantive sourcing, invoicing, and settlement functions; projected cash flow model; copy of the lithium carbonate purchase agreement with identified upstream supplier.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Counterparty exposure to high-risk trade corridors (e.g., People's Republic of China and Hong Kong SAR) for battery-grade lithium carbonate procurement
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Trade counterparty KYC pack including business registration abstracts, beneficial ownership details, license to trade battery-grade chemicals, ISO/MSDS documentation for the lithium carbonate cargo, recent utility bills of the supplier, and independent sanctions screening report for all counterparties.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Rapid inbound capital injection shortly after incorporation inconsistent with trading turnover
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Shareholder source-of-funds dossier (six-month bank statements, tax returns, sale of equity or real estate settlements); execution-ready purchase order and pro forma invoice matching the injected amount; sworn affidavit explaining the funding chain; commodity trade finance term sheet validating the working capital requirement.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High-risk activities screening flags for physical commodity trading and battery metals arbitrage
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Banking AML risk tier self-assessment; institutional compliance manual; ISO 9001 or similar quality certifications; identity of the end-user and export destination; customs and export license confirmations; details of the final battery manufacturer offtake to demonstrate a legitimate physical trade.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Inbound capital injection must be routed as SWIFT MT103 (customer credit transfer) from the shareholder's bank to the RMI operating account, with the beneficiary account clearly identified and the purpose code referencing 'Equity contribution' or 'Shareholder loan' under the applicable U.S. correspondent bank message standard. Recommended narrative field: 'Capital subscription per board resolution dated [date] MH__MH__MH_BC'. A copy of the share subscription agreement and board resolution should be pre-delivered to the receiving bank to avoid funds being returned as unclear. Amounts above USD 250,000 may trigger enhanced due diligence review; supporting source-of-wealth documents must be available.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Trade settlements for battery-grade lithium carbonate should be executed through SWIFT MT103 for straight-up open account payments and through MT700 (documentary credit issuance) with MT707 (amendment) for standby and commercial letters of credit governed by UCP 600. For high-value cargos, a confirmed irrevocable letter of credit issued by Bank of Marshall Islands and advised through a first-class Asian confirming bank (e.g., in Hong Kong or Singapore) is the preferred rail. Correspondent settlement is in USD via U.S. Federal Reserve Fedwire or CHIPS; MT202 COV covering transfers must be used where the payment is routed through one or more intermediary banks. All outbound messages should carry the purpose code for merchandise trade (e.g., 'Trade payment - goods' or code 110/111 equivalents) and the underlying contract number for reconciliation.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: USD/CNH Non-Deliverable Forwards (NDF) cleared through Hong Kong or Singapore licensed banks
USD/CNY deliverable forwards via a foreign branch of the RMI bank or a licensed Asian counterparty when the underlying trade has CNY invoice settlement legs
Cross-currency swaps (USD against CNH or CNY) for matched lithium carbonate purchase commitments exceeding USD 1 million notional
Vanilla FX options (USD call / CNH put and USD put / CNH call) with premium settled in USD for hedging procurement price uncertainty
Collateralized commodity trade finance swaps combining interest rate and FX components, provided the bank has an ISDA 2002 master agreement or an FX annex in place

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Report of the Business Corporation (confirming registered agent, directors, officers, and share capital)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registrar of Corporations, Marshall Islands (submitted through licensed registered agent)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: On or before the last day of the month of the anniversary date of incorporation in each calendar year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late fee of US$100 is added for overdue filing; continued delinquency beyond approximately 90 days renders the corporation liable to administrative strike-off/dissolution by the Registrar.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: None for a non-resident private business corporation; mandatory audit is not triggered by size, revenue, or share capital. An independent audit may become required only if the corporation is listed, ordered by shareholders holding at least 20% of voting shares, or imposed by a lender or contractual covenant.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: No mandatory local statutory GAAP; voluntarily prepared financial statements are commonly presented under IFRS or US GAAP, with the registered office maintaining books that reflect the corporation's financial condition.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: RMI law does not require an annual UBO return to the Registrar. The Annual Report confirms only registered agent, directors, officers, and share capital; the registered agent must maintain and update beneficial ownership/KYC information whenever transfers occur or at annual re-verification under applicable AML/CFT obligations.

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: Not compulsory; if voluntarily prepared, US$5,000–US$12,000 per audit

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 3% on RMI-source net income for resident corporations; effective 0% for Non-Resident Domestic Corporations (NRDC) with no Marshall Islands-sourced trading income
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Tax_Exempt_Zone classification: foreign-source procurement and resale income exempt; no capital gains tax, no branch tax, no net worth tax; annual fiscal burden limited to BCCA franchise tax of US$250–US$500 depending on authorized capital

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: BCCA Annual Report & Franchise Tax Return (Form MI-AR) filed through licensed Registered Agent via RMI Registrar of Corporations e-Registry portal; income tax returns for locally liable entities filed on paper with RMI Revenue and Taxation Office (RTO), Majuro
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Annual Report due on the last day of the calendar month of the incorporation anniversary; income tax return, where liability exists, due on or before April 30 following the close of the December 31 tax year

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Corporation name and RMI entity number
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Enter exact legal name as per Articles of Incorporation and certificate number; no DBAs permitted

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Registered agent name and physical address in Marshall Islands
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Must be a licensed RMI registered agent; P.O. Box alone is insufficient
State full street address of the registered agent's office in Majuro

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Directors and officers: full names, nationalities, residential addresses
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: List all directors and officers; minimum of one director and one president/treasurer required under BCCA

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Authorized share capital: number of shares, par value, and currency
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: State authorized shares in USD; franchisetax computation is derived from this field
Confirm that no business is transacted within RMI and no RMI-source income will be derived; attaches Section 120 exemption election
Describe as cross-border wholesale procurement and resale of battery-grade lithium carbonate (ISIC 4662); avoid vague or residual descriptors

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Economic substance status and foreign tax residence declaration
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Claim ESR exclusion only if tax-resident and subject to income tax in a qualifying foreign jurisdiction; attach supporting certificate
Compute US$250 floor or US$500 for authorized capital above US$50,000; remit wire via registered agent

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Certification of accuracy by director, officer, or registered agent
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Must be signed under penalty of perjury; electronically binding on the entity and signatory

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing penalty of US$500 (BCCA); franchise tax arrears accrue interest at 1% per month; non-filing for 12+ months triggers administrative dissolution, forfeiture of legal capacity, and reinstatement fees of up to US$1,000

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 0% (RMI imposes no dividend withholding tax on distributions to non-resident shareholders)
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: No comprehensive double tax agreement (DTA) is in force; because statutory WHT is already 0%, no treaty relief claim or reduced-rate application is required at source. Where a Tax Residency Certificate (TRC) is sought for banking or foreign tax credit purposes, submit Form TRC-RMI to RTO with: certificate of incorporation, registered agent confirmation, NRDC declaration, foreign tax residence proof, and processing fee; issuance typically within 10 business days.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Royalties: 0% domestic / 0% under any applicable TIEA-based arrangement; Interest: 0% domestic / 0% treaty; no RMI statutory withholding applies to payments of debt interest or IP royalties to foreign related parties

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: USD; no statutory Local File, Master File, or CbCR threshold exists under RMI law; transfer pricing documentation is not statutorily mandated, but arm's-length margin evidence must be retained for Economic Substance (Distribution and Service Centre) compliance, including intercompany purchase orders, resale invoices, and commission/warehouse agreements
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: RMI Economic Substance (Exemptions) Regulations 2019 apply to Relevant Entities conducting Relevant Activities, which expressly include Distribution and Service Centre operations such as cross-border lithium carbonate procurement and arbitrage resale. CIGA (core income-generating activities) must be managed and directed in RMI, with adequate premises, full-time employees, and operating expenditure proportional to income. An NRDC may claim exclusion if it is tax resident in a qualifying foreign jurisdiction and subject to income tax there. Annual ESR-1 declaration required; non-compliance attracts penalties up to US$10,000 plus daily default surcharges.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Filing false NRDC declarations or deliberately mischaracterizing RMI-source sales as foreign-source arbitrage income to escape the 3% RMI corporate tax; suppressing invoices for lithium carbonate deliveries arranged from an RMI permanent establishment
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Civil fraud penalty of 50% of the tax deficiency plus monthly underpayment interest at 1.5%; late-filing and non-payment surcharges up to 25% of the assessed tax; criminal prosecution under Title 54 RMC with conviction leading to fines of US$10,000 and/or imprisonment up to 5 years
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors signing false declarations are jointly and severally liable for tax restitution and civil penalties; criminal conviction triggers travel bans, exit restrictions, and compulsory surrender of passports

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Operating as a pure shell: no physical office in Majuro, no ENSA/board meetings in RMI, no substance records for buy-sell logistics, claiming ESR exclusion while failing to prove foreign tax residence, or outsourcing all CIGA to non-resident nominees
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: ESR penalty of US$10,000 plus US$500 per day for continuing breach; administrative strike-off or dissolution by the Registrar; forfeiture of the corporate name; referral to the RMI Financial Intelligence Unit
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Knowing participation exposes directors to personal civil liability for unpaid penalties, disqualification orders prohibiting board service, and imprisonment of up to 12 months for ESR filing evasion

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Over-invoicing or under-invoicing battery-grade lithium carbonate shipments, routing Swift_LC and wire payments through layered shell intermediaries, splitting wire transfers below USD 10,000 reporting thresholds, or failing to file STR/SUSTR on suspicious counterparty activity
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: RMI Anti-Money Laundering Act 2015: fines up to US$200,000 per offence plus confiscation of transaction proceeds; aggravated or repeat offences carry imprisonment up to 10 years
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and designated compliance officers are personally liable for AML reporting failures; asset freezing orders, international travel alerts, and Interpol Red Notices may be issued; corporate veil is pierced for AML fraud

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Sanctions Evasion and Fatal Audit Exposure
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Sourcing lithium carbonate from OFAC, UN, or EU-sanctioned producers (e.g., DPRK, Iran, or forced-labor-tainted Xinjiang supply chains) and falsifying country-of-origin declarations or shipment documents to clear AML compliance checks at correspondent banks
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: OFAC secondary sanctions exposure: civil penalties of up to US$250,000 per transaction or twice the transaction value; immediate de-risking and termination of correspondent banking lines; RMI regulator referral to FinCEN and FATF
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors face personal civil liability and criminal indictment under the International Emergency Economic Powers Act in the United States; veil-piercing applies for sanctions fraud, with consequent travel bans, seizure of personal assets, and extradition risk under mutual legal assistance treaties
